C4.note: anchorFor() derives interior anchors from d.bounds_m, and applyInteriorBounds() mutates the same record objects, so NPC posts inside a shrunk room follow the shrink. The failure mode to look for is not "out of reach" but an inset larger than the half-extent.

mesh_hidden.note: if equal, the signature counts meshes that are visible:false

only_a_light_differs.note: if equal, the signature is blind to lighting — conservative for a distinctness claim

instance_number_only.note: names are stripped of trailing digits by design
